High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready copy of the Players Committee virtual card [[Sidon Ithano]] (Virtual Set 7, Dark Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Virtual Cards/Set 7/Dark/Sidon Ithano.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1O2js74OpeKEhbEBSv6rOz-dB0hQW7fhO/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Sidon Ithano.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,340,768 bytes, SHA-256 <code>77f9657c6b9d0af969e7241aca4f5da8562946f3ab409a2b9480ebbd8abffa64</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 44.5, 46.0, 73.0, 55.5 px); resized: no; no other change.

The regular face of this card on its article stays [[:File:V7-D-sidonithano-2018-07-08.gif]].

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project. Fair use rationale: this is an image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. (card design by the Players Committee). It is used only to identify and study the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.
